subject.title: Feature Request: WhatsApp sticker send support

question: Should the first supported WhatsApp sticker contract transport only sticker-ready WebP, or also convert arbitrary static and animated media into WhatsApp-compatible stickers?
rationale: Both approaches are feasible, but conversion materially expands validation, dependencies, failure behavior, and long-term media ownership; source inspection cannot determine the intended product scope.

options.title: Sticker-ready transport first
options.body: Expose an explicit sticker action or option that accepts validated WhatsApp-ready WebP and reports actionable errors for incompatible media, leaving conversion to a later capability.

options.title: Built-in conversion pipeline
options.body: Accept broader image and animation inputs and own resizing, WebP encoding, animation chunks, metadata, limits, and failure handling in the WhatsApp plugin.

recommendation.title: Sticker-ready transport first
recommendation.body: Expose an explicit sticker action or option that accepts validated WhatsApp-ready WebP and reports actionable errors for incompatible media, leaving conversion to a later capability.
